snippet.title: Attack of the Astrals | Turn-based Strategy | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🚨 ANNOUNCEMENT: We are happy to reveal that Attack of the Astrals is officially joining the Goblinz Publishing lineup! Discover this brand-new tactical roguelike where every movement is a deadly strike.

🎮 Wishlist Attack of the Astrals on Steam NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991790/Attack_of_the_Astrals?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=reveal_trailer

Developed by Hewer's Workshop and published by Goblinz, Attack of the Astrals is a deep turn-based tactical RPG that blends cosmic fantasy with intense combat mechanics. Master the unique "movement equals attack" system, position yourself perfectly, and outsmart hordes of enemies in this highly strategic indie gem.

✨ Key Features:
- Movement is your weapon: Plan your steps carefully in this innovative tactical puzzle system.
- Deep Turn-Based Strategy: Anticipate enemy patterns and unleash devastating combos.
- Cosmic Fantasy World: Dive into a gorgeous pixel-art universe filled with unique astrals and dangerous foes.

Don't forget to Like, Subscribe, and hit the Bell icon to never miss an update on Attack of the Astrals and other Goblinz tactical games!

#AttackOfTheAstrals #GoblinzPublishing #TacticalRPG #Roguelike #IndieGame #TurnBasedStrategy
